name: feedback_id
description: Unique identifier for the feedback record

name: feedback_text
description: Raw feedback text from the customer

name: created_at
description: Original timestamp when feedback was submitted

name: feedback_date
description: Date extracted from created_at, used for partitioning

name: day_of_week
description: Day of week extracted from created_at

name: is_weekend
description: Whether created_at falls on a weekend

name: sentiment_label
description: LLM-classified sentiment: very_negative, negative, neutral, positive, very_positive

name: sentiment_score
description: Numeric confidence score from the LLM (0.0-1.0)

name: ingestion_ts
description: Timestamp when the record was ingested into BigQuery
